locator: The Road to Full Automation and Levels 0-5
observations: Levels 0-2 require the driver to drive and monitor.
Level 3 requires the driver to be available to take over when requested.
Levels 4-5 shift the driving task to the system within their defined conditions.
NHTSA states that the highest automation currently available to consumers still requires full driver engagement and attention.
limitations: United States availability and regulatory context; Turkey availability and legal duties require separate verification.
